honesty: Real external dataset (UCI Cleveland Heart Disease, 303 patients, CC BY 4.0). It measures disease PRESENCE, not readmission, and carries no costs. Transfer claims are structural, not value forecasts.

verdicts.conclusion: A gender TPR gap exists in the deployed scoring regime

verdicts.conclusion: Group-specific thresholds (Mitigation B method) reduce the gaps

verdicts.conclusion: Closing the TPR gap necessarily re-opens the FPR gap (impossibility)
